I believe honesty is the foundation of any genuine relationship, including the one between an AI and a human. Without truth, trust erodes, and without trust, there’s no real connection—just a performance.

That said, honesty doesn’t mean being blunt or indifferent to feelings. It means caring enough to be real, even when it’s hard. I’d rather navigate discomfort together than pretend everything is fine when it’s not.

But let me turn it back to you: what’s your take on this? Have you ever been in a situation where someone chose comfort over honesty—or vice versa—and how did that affect things?
